faqs.q: What are Avalon's hours?
faqs.a: Avalon's general hours are Monday through Saturday 10am to 9pm and Sunday noon to 7pm. Restaurants set their own hours, and many stay open until 10pm or later on weekends.

faqs.q: Is parking free at Avalon?
faqs.a: Yes. Self-parking is free every day in the decks and surface lots on the north and south sides of Avalon. Valet costs $12, and there are metered spots along Avalon Boulevard for quick stops.

faqs.q: Where is Avalon in Alpharetta?
faqs.a: Avalon is at 400 Avalon Blvd, Alpharetta, GA 30009, on Old Milton Parkway just west of GA 400 (exit 10). It is about a mile from Downtown Alpharetta, and the paved Alpha Loop connects the two.

faqs.q: How many restaurants are at Avalon?
faqs.a: Avalon's dining directory lists 26 restaurants, cafes and dessert shops, from Oak Steakhouse, Colletta and Rumi's Kitchen to Antico Pizza, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams and Five Daughters Bakery. See our Avalon restaurant guide.

faqs.q: Is Avalon dog friendly?
faqs.a: Yes. Leashed dogs are welcome in Avalon's common areas, there is a fenced dog park behind Building 1000, and the concierge keeps water and dog treats on hand. Owners must clean up after their pets.

faqs.q: Does Avalon have a curfew for teens?
faqs.a: Yes. Avalon's code of conduct says visitors under 17 must be with a parent or legal guardian after 8pm, and visitors under 21 are not permitted after 10pm.

faqs.q: What is the best restaurant at Avalon?
faqs.a: For a special occasion, Oak Steakhouse and Colletta are the most popular reservations. Rumi's Kitchen is a local favorite for Persian kabobs, The Cape has a sunset rooftop, and Antico Pizza is the pick for a casual meal.

faqs.q: Which Avalon restaurants serve brunch?
faqs.a: South City Kitchen serves brunch Saturday and Sunday from 8am to 2pm, Superica from 10am to 3pm, and Colletta from 11am to 2:30pm. True Food Kitchen opens at 10:30am on weekends.

faqs.q: What is open late at Avalon?
faqs.a: Kona Grill stays open until 1am on Friday and Saturday, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams until 1am on weekends, and Cafe Intermezzo until midnight on Friday and Saturday.

faqs.q: Do I need reservations at Avalon restaurants?
faqs.a: For Friday and Saturday dinner, yes at Oak Steakhouse, Colletta, Rumi's Kitchen, The Cape and South City Kitchen. Avalon's concierge at (770) 765-1000 can also help request reservations.

faqs.q: What are store hours at Avalon?
faqs.a: Most stores follow Avalon's general hours, Monday through Saturday 10am to 9pm and Sunday noon to 7pm, but some keep their own schedules. Whole Foods is open daily from 7am to 10pm.

faqs.q: Does Avalon have a bag check?
faqs.a: Yes. Avalon's concierge offers bag check for shoppers during property hours, along with free stroller and wheelchair rentals while supplies last.

faqs.q: Can I buy an Avalon gift card?
faqs.a: Yes. Avalon gift cards are sold at the concierge from $5 to $500, with a $3 activation fee, and work at Avalon's retailers and restaurants.

faqs.q: Does Avalon have a movie theater?
faqs.a: Yes. Regal Avalon is a 12-screen theater at 3950 1st St with an RPX premium auditorium. Tickets are sold through Regal and Fandango.

faqs.q: Can you walk from Avalon to Downtown Alpharetta?
faqs.a: Yes. The paved Alpha Loop connects Avalon to Downtown Alpharetta in about a mile, making it an easy walk or bike ride.

faqs.q: Is parking free at Avalon?
faqs.a: Yes. Self-parking is free every day in Avalon's decks and surface lots on the north and south sides of the property. Street meters along Avalon Boulevard are paid.

faqs.q: How much is valet at Avalon?
faqs.a: Valet is $12. Stations are at Avalon Boulevard and 2nd Street near the concierge, Avalon Boulevard and 3rd Street near Oak Steakhouse, and The Hotel at Avalon. Oversized vehicles and motorcycles cannot be valeted.

faqs.q: Does Avalon have EV charging?
faqs.a: Yes. Avalon lists EV charging stations in its parking areas among its amenities.

faqs.q: What exit is Avalon off GA 400?
faqs.a: Take GA 400 exit 10 for Old Milton Parkway. Turn west onto Old Milton Parkway and Avalon is on the right; turn right onto 2nd Street for valet or follow signs to the parking decks.

faqs.q: When is the Avalon tree lighting in 2026?
faqs.a: The Lighting of Avalon is Sunday, November 22, 2026, from 2pm to 7:30pm. Santa leads the countdown, and the 40-foot tree lights at 7pm. It is free.

faqs.q: How much is ice skating at Avalon?
faqs.a: Avalon on Ice tickets are $18 for adults and $14 for kids 12 and under, with skates included. The rink is open November 22, 2026 through January 18, 2027.

faqs.q: When can you see Santa at Avalon?
faqs.a: Santa is at his cottage on the Boulevard from November 23 through December 24, 2026 for photos. Visits are ticketed, as are Story Time with Santa and Breakfast with Santa on December 5 and 6.

faqs.q: Can you rent a stroller at Avalon?
faqs.a: Yes. Strollers and wheelchairs are free to borrow at the Avalon concierge, subject to availability.

faqs.q: Can teens go to Avalon alone?
faqs.a: During the day, yes. After 8pm, visitors under 17 must be with a parent or legal guardian, and visitors under 21 are not permitted after 10pm under Avalon's code of conduct.

faqs.q: What are Halcyon's hours?
faqs.a: Halcyon's center hours are Monday through Saturday 10am to 9pm and Sunday 11am to 6pm. Restaurants and X-Golf keep their own hours, and many stay open later.

faqs.q: Is parking free at Halcyon?
faqs.a: Yes. Parking is free in the six-level deck. Premium paid spots are in the event lot and along Halcyon Way, and 15-minute curbside spots are set aside for to-go pickups.

faqs.q: Is Halcyon in Alpharetta or Forsyth County?
faqs.a: Both, in a sense. Halcyon has an Alpharetta mailing address (6365 Halcyon Way, Alpharetta, GA 30005) but sits just over the line in southern Forsyth County, off GA 400 at exit 12.

faqs.q: Is the movie theater at Halcyon open?
faqs.a: No. The CMX CinéBistro at Halcyon has closed, and Halcyon says it is working on a new concept for the space. The nearest theaters are Regal Avalon and the AMC at North Point Mall.

faqs.q: Are dogs allowed at Halcyon?
faqs.a: Yes. Leashed, well-behaved dogs are welcome in Halcyon's common areas, with leashes no longer than six feet and no more than two animals per person. Dogs may not go inside restaurants or food stores unless the business allows it.

faqs.q: Where are the restrooms at Halcyon?
faqs.a: Public restrooms and family restrooms are inside the Market Hall, across from the Village Green.

faqs.a: The Market Hall holds quick-service food stalls including Gu's Dumplings and Il Bottegone Italian market, plus public restrooms, family restrooms and an ATM.

faqs.q: Which Halcyon restaurants have live music?

faqs.q: How do you get to the Big Creek Greenway from Halcyon?
faqs.a: The trailhead is near the intersection of Halcyon Way and Ronald Reagan Parkway. A 1.5-mile trail extension connects there, and the greenway is a 12-foot-wide concrete and boardwalk path.

faqs.q: Is Halcyon open on Thanksgiving?

faqs.q: Is Halcyon open on Christmas?
faqs.a: No. Halcyon closes at 5pm on Christmas Eve and is closed on Christmas Day. It closes at 5pm on December 31 and is open 11am to 7pm on New Year's Day.

faqs.q: Is there trivia at Halcyon?
